stories.dek: Lyssna breaks down the trends separating hype from reality: design systems evolving into governance platforms, spatial UI moving from novelty to production, and privacy becoming a perceivable product feature.

stories.headline: 366 Design Jobs in Barcelona: May 2026 Glassdoor Snapshot
stories.dek: Glassdoor's Barcelona design job count hits 366 in May 2026, with salaries for senior product designer roles averaging around €76,000 annually — and a cluster of listings at fintech, travel-tech, and digital health companies.
